judgement.reason: Flipt v2 keeps its core flag data in Git repositories, which appear to live on the server's local disk, and Deployz has no persistent volumes; the shown lines do not prove whether remote SCM sync makes the container stateless.

evidence.quote: - **Own your data**: Store feature flags directly in your Git repositories
| **Storage** | Database-centric (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite) | Git-native with optional SCM sync (GitHub, GitLab, BitBucket, Azure DevOps, Gitea, etc.) |
